turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My eyes feel tired after an evening on my phone. Is the brightness doing that?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Partly, yes. Turn on auto-brightness so it dims in dark rooms, and try the night light or warm screen setting after sunset.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The warm one makes everything look yellow. It's kind of gross.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can adjust how warm it gets. Even a gentle shift helps, it doesn't have to look like an old photo.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to save for a holiday next summer and I have a few plans in mind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Options first, Moshi, then your take.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is to save a fixed amount from every paycheck into a separate holiday pot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is the round up thing, where the app rounds up every purchase and saves the change.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could pick up extra shifts at the cafe on weekends just for the holiday money.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How far off is the holiday? If it's a while, the fixed transfer plus round ups on top is easy and steady. Save the extra shifts in case you fall behind.
